improvement is needed!
Sep 2026 • Couples
We know thai food as a tasty and with many choices, however this chain restaurant in Danang does not offer many choices, menu is rather limited, and staff is not ready to change anything in the dish to accommodate person's need. One dish, very popular everywhere in Thai cooking, is Krapao, basil and chilli chicken, in this restaurant does not exist. There is no paper services, only wet ones but you need to pay to use them, they will be paid for in your bill. When asked for dry paper services, I was ignored, simply. Language is also the issue; majority of staff doesn't have even very basic English. To summarize, not good place to visit if you really want to experience yummy thai food and thai hospitality

The flavors and the décor
Jun 2026 • Family
For a Thai restaurant located in Da Nang, Vietnam, the quality of the flavors here is truly impressive. Complemented by classic-style décor, the setting creates a warm and inviting atmosphere—something well worth experiencing. While other elements may shift with the passage of time, the authentic essence of the Thai flavors remains constant.
The flavors and the décor—these are the things I love about it, and why I want to recommend it to you.
